findings.title: Migration interpolates host value into raw SQL
findings.body: The migration builds INSERT with "VALUES ('#{h}', ..." where h comes from the site_settings.embeddable_hosts value. A host containing a single quote breaks the statement or injects SQL, failing or corrupting the migration. Use quoted/bind parameters or ActiveRecord model creation instead of string interpolation.

findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category setting is empty
findings.body: The migration does execute(...WHERE s.name='embed_category')[0]['id'] unconditionally. If the setting is blank, missing, or does not match a category name, [0] is nil and calling ['id'] raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration for all installs that never configured embedding. Guard for nil/empty results before dereferencing.

findings.title: before_validation crashes on nil host
findings.body: The callback calls self.host.sub! twice without checking presence. Creating/updating an EmbeddableHost with nil host (e.g. missing param or failed fabricator) raises NoMethodError instead of a validation error, turning a 422 into a 500.

findings.title: Case-insensitive host lookup compares lower() to non-lowered value
findings.body: record_for_host does where("lower(host) = ?", host) where host is URI.host as-is. If the request or stored host has uppercase characters the comparison fails because the right side is not downcased, so host_allowed? incorrectly rejects a configured host. Downcase the argument before comparison.

findings.title: update/destroy dereference nil when host not found
findings.body: update does EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first then save_host(host) and destroy does host.destroy without a nil check. An unknown id causes NoMethodError on nil and a 500 instead of 404. Render not-found when the record is missing.

findings.title: Passes category_id where PostCreator expects category name
findings.body: The old code passed category: SiteSetting.embed_category which is a category name string. The new code passes category: eh.try(:category_id), an integer id. If PostCreator resolves category by name, embedded topics will get the wrong/no category or fail validation. Pass the expected type (name or category_id parameter).

findings.title: Only first underscore is normalized in admin-model check
findings.body: basePath uses type.replace('_','-') which replaces only the first underscore. Any multi-word type with more than one underscore will not match ADMIN_MODELS and will use the non-admin "/" prefix, producing 404s. Use a global replace.

findings.title: Plural embedded ids can throw or hydrate to undefined entries
findings.body: In _hydrateEmbedded the m[2] branch unconditionally does obj[k].map(...). If the *_ids key is null/missing it throws, and if any id has no match _lookupSubType returns undefined, leaving holes in the array while hydrated || [] never triggers because map always returns an array. Guard for non-arrays and filter missing lookups.
